sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-37"
sources.quote: Kepler-37, also known as UGA-1785, is a G-type main-sequence star located in the constellation Lyra 209 light-years from Earth.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Bonomo et al. 2023.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-37"
sources.quote: It is host to exoplanets Kepler-37b, Kepler-37c, Kepler-37d and possibly Kepler-37e, all of which orbit very close to it.
